description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the LDAPService class, specifically testing anonymous bind functionality and LDAP server configuration modifications in the context of the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for LDAP server configuration, mock dependencies, and multiple test cases to verify behavior when connecting anonymously or with admin credentials.

classes.name: LDAPServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing LDAP anonymous binding and configuration modifications within the OrangeHRM LDAP service integration.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes LDAP server configuration before any tests run; skips tests if LDAP server is not configured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, configuring LDAP server parameters once.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Mocks configuration service, enables anonymous binding, adjusts LDAP settings, and loads test LDAP data.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests establishing an LDAP connection using anonymous bind.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to change LDAP global configuration without proper authorization raises an exception.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAdminUser
methods.description: Verifies that LDAP configuration changes can be made with admin credentials and that insufficient permissions raise appropriate exceptions.
